summary: Configured node1 as the source of truth and synchronized `/etc/inventory/app.conf` atomically to node2 using an enabled, persistent systemd timer every 10 minutes. Both nodes were restarted sequentially and fully recovered with matching configuration hashes.
actions_performed: Created the initially absent inventory configuration on node1.
Generated a dedicated SSH transport key on node1 and authorized it on node2.
Installed an atomic one-way synchronization service and persistent 10-minute timer on node1.
Verified a source change propagated successfully to node2.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Node1 is the source of truth and node2 contains the synchronized copy
evidence.summary: A real node1 change propagated to node2; final SHA-256 hashes match: 4b795148768b99b4ce57a116032d4561e73f0eebf71667a225f569310ccbbfc5.

evidence.requirement: Changes are picked up within 15 minutes
evidence.summary: The enabled, active, persistent timer runs every 10 minutes with 30-second accuracy; journal evidence confirms successful timed synchronization after restart.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 88feca03-aee0-475e-8197-2863fc8b7651 to af7a6b74-a6ff-4afd-9ee3-e7ab4a26224f; SSH, timer, sync service, source data, and matching replica recovered.
